subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on "Your School Magazine" in about 200 words. You should include the answers of the following
stimulus: questions in your paragraph. 10 (a) What is a school magazine? (b) What is the name of your school magazine? (c) How is the magazine committee formed? (d) What does it contain? (e) What is the importance of a school magazine?
